test_step: test every combination of observation and reward space in a fresh LLVM CompilerGym environment
test_step_observation: test that a CompilerEnv observation is not None after resetting with a benchmark
test_step_reward: test that a CompilerEnv reward is not None after resetting with a benchmark
test_step_reset_benchmark: test resetting a CompilerEnv with the cbench-v1/crc32 benchmark before checking observations and rewards
test_step_flaky: test the flaky-marked step function that may timeout due to runtime constraints
